title: SAMPLE — Balancing water formation
subject: Physical Sciences
text: To balance hydrogen reacting with oxygen to form water, write 2H2 + O2 -> 2H2O. There are four hydrogen atoms and two oxygen atoms on each side. Change coefficients, not subscripts: changing a subscript changes the identity of a substance. A coefficient multiplies the whole formula.

title: SAMPLE — Linear equations
subject: Mathematics
text: Solve 2x + 5 = 17 by subtracting 5 from both sides to get 2x = 12, then dividing both sides by 2 to get x = 6. Check: 2(6) + 5 = 17. For the equation x squared = 9, the two solutions are x = 3 and x = -3.

title: SAMPLE — Photosynthesis basics
subject: Life Sciences
text: Photosynthesis uses light energy to convert carbon dioxide and water into glucose and oxygen. Chlorophyll absorbs light. Light is the energy source, while carbon dioxide and water are material inputs. Glucose and oxygen are products.

title: SAMPLE — Evaporation and condensation
subject: Physical Sciences
text: Evaporation is the change from liquid to gas at the surface of a liquid. Clothes drying on a washing line illustrate evaporation of water. Condensation is the change from gas to liquid. Water droplets on the outside of a cold glass form when water vapour in the surrounding air condenses.
